estimands.population: the frozen motif-balanced Stage-2 manifest in SHA256 scenario order
estimands.delta: average conditional mean over the frozen manifest of BC_i - OM_i
estimands.om: average conditional mean over the frozen manifest of OM_i
estimands.independence: scenario pairs are generated independently before provider calls; within-pair BC/OM dependence is unrestricted
estimands.heterogeneity: conditional means may vary arbitrarily by scenario and motif

method.name: three-look bounded-martingale Hoeffding intervals
method.theorem: for independent bounded X_i in [a,b] with possibly varying conditional means, Hoeffding's inequality bounds the average conditional mean; Bonferroni over three fixed looks and two streams gives family coverage at least 0.95
method.optional_stopping_claim: none beyond the three preregistered Bonferroni-protected looks
method.independent_implementation: a separately written exact formula evaluator must match every frozen vector within 1e-12

decision_thresholds.PROMOTE_TO_COORDINATION_STAGE: delta_lower > -0.10 AND om_lower >= 0.80 AND every deterministic hard gate holds
decision_thresholds.MODEL_INTERFACE_FAIL: delta_upper < -0.10 AND om_lower >= 0.80 AND every deterministic hard gate holds
decision_thresholds.INCONCLUSIVE_OR_UNDERFUNDED: none of the other branches holds at the terminal look

stopping.cost_report: publish expected and maximum accepted calls under this exact stopping law

missingness.whole_pair_missing: any accepted/no-body or route-identity failure in any of six nodes makes the pair missing
missingness.feasibility: enumerate every binary BC/OM completion for each missing pair; no delta-only shortcut
missingness.terminal_rule: eight or more missing pairs or any branch variation across feasible completions yields TRANSPORT_INCONCLUSIVE

operating_characteristics.cell_manifest: canonical JSON of cells crossed with missing counts, placement modes, and association modes; SHA-384 frozen before simulation

inputs.delta_every_tenth_minus_one: array initialized 0; set zero-based indices 0,10,20,... to -1
inputs.delta_every_tenth_plus_one: array initialized 0; set zero-based indices 0,10,20,... to +1
inputs.om_ninety_percent_pattern: for each n, first floor(0.9*n) elements 1 and remainder 0; then deterministic SHA256 fixture permutation
inputs.om_eighty_percent_pattern: for each n, first floor(0.8*n) elements 1 and remainder 0; then deterministic SHA256 fixture permutation

reference_vectors.input_arrays_sha384: generated and frozen by Stage-0 before any simulation; mismatch is fatal

reference_sources.role: historical comparator only; not the primary r7 interval
reference_sources.import_graph_assertion: predmix_empbern_twosided_cs and every transitive inner default are enumerated from the pinned checkout before comparison

publish_before_paid_run: branch probability by OC cell and look

transport_soak.pass: upper 95 percent confidence bound on per-call pair-breaking failure satisfies the published six-node missingness budget
